status: Acquisition/admission specification only. VCF, TBI and mask bodies not downloaded in CORE/PREP.

vcf.binding: Provider HEAD checked 2026-11-01; record actual body SHA256 at future acquisition

tbi.binding: Retain original provider index. Source workflow does not use it to crop the complete contig.

mask.binding: Original whole-chromosome strict mask FASTA; P means project accessibility, not per-sample callability.

scientific_policy.region: Complete contig positions 1-51304566 inclusive, no subsetting/resampling/replication
scientific_policy.sites: PASS, P-accessible, literal A/C/G/T SNVs; retain multiallelic SNVs and report all exclusive exclusions
scientific_policy.gt: Selected full YRI/CEU cohort in original VCF order; numeric diploid calls or complete diploid missing; reject partial/non-diploid/out-of-range alleles before read_vcf
scientific_policy.shape: Admit actual maximum ALT width over all original records; genotype/i2 and Number=2 explicitly bound; no default ALT/GT truncation
scientific_policy.ancestral: Original INFO/AA first nucleotide token uniquely matching REF/ALT, preserving raw case/suffix; no REF fallback or GRCh38 substitute
scientific_policy.sfs: Biallelic records complete in relevant population(s), fixed 216/198 chromosome axes, no projection; unfolded additionally requires usable AA; bin0 only among supplied records
scientific_policy.uncertainty: Pinned source 10000-variant jackknife: all-row point estimate, full-block resampling only, residual tail disclosed; not bp blocks or demographic confidence intervals

documentation.interpretation: Masked variant-callset compatibility only; no unbiased biological diversity, independent-person, clinical ancestry, selection or demographic claim

privacy: Keep originals, joins, row-level artifacts, logs and manifests private. Hosted acquisition/execution/encrypted-retention admission is parent-owned and not implemented here.

proposed_budget.finalization_overhead: Parent must include admitted encryption/retention overhead before execution; do not reduce contig/cohort/output scope to fit.
